theme: the color that the theme gives this place; palette: a named palette color; custom: the color's own values for the light and the dark theme.

The color for the dark theme; at least one of light and dark is present.
One side of a custom color: the value, and whether a person chose the value or GRS derived the value. One side may be absent; GRS derives the missing side from the other side when opening the file.
The color value for this theme.
chosen: a person chose this value; derived: GRS made the value from the other side when loading the document.
